source: Cox, S. C., Smith Lyttle, B., Elkind, S., Smith Siddoway, C. S., Morin, P., Capponi, G., et al., 2023. The GeoMAP (v.2022-08) continent-wide detailed geological dataset of Antarctica. PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482. Described in: A continent-wide detailed geological map dataset of Antarctica, Scientific Data 10, 250, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02152-9. CC BY 4.0.
method: GeoMAP geological units with GRPEQUIV 'Byrd Group', by formation (FMNEQUIV); rings simplified to 250 m and those under 0.25 km² dropped (scripts/outcrops_geomap.py). Present-day outcrop, not depositional extent. Ages from the section's record (Myrow et al. 2002); GeoMAP gives the whole group 485–541 Ma. Measured sections S1, S2, HR located on Myrow et al. 2002, fig. 1.

stratigraphy_note.ko: Myrow et al. 2002의 개정 층서: 섀클턴 석회암 위를 얇은 홀리오크층이 덮고 그 위에 스타샷층이 쌓인다. 더글러스 역암은 홀리오크층 높이부터 스타샷층과 옆으로 맞물리는 안쪽(대륙 쪽) 쐐기다. GeoMAP은 홀리오크층을 따로 그리지 않는다.
stratigraphy_note.en: Myrow et al. 2002, revised stratigraphy: the thin Holyoake Formation caps the Shackleton Limestone and the Starshot Formation lies above; the Douglas Conglomerate is an inboard wedge interfingering with the Starshot from the Holyoake level up. GeoMAP does not map the Holyoake separately.
